chapter_name: Grassroots Democracy - Part 3: Local Government in Urban Areas
learning_objective: 🎯 Discover who keeps our big, busy cities running smoothly, clears the garbage, and fixes the streetlights every single day!

main_concepts.concept_title: 🏙️ Managing the Big Cities: Municipal Corporations
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Cities are huge and crowded! To manage them, we have a big local government called the Municipal Corporation. For smaller towns, we have a Municipal Council or Municipality.

main_concepts.concept_title: 🏘️ Dividing the City: Wards and Councillors
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Because a city is too big for one person to manage, it is sliced into smaller areas called Wards. People in each ward vote to elect a Ward Councillor to solve their local street problems.

main_concepts.concept_title: 🧹 Civic Amenities: Making City Life Good
main_concepts.simple_explanation: The city government's job is to provide civic amenities. This means they collect the garbage, keep the drinking water clean, run city buses, and maintain beautiful parks for you to play in!

fun_activity.title: 👔 Mayor for a Day
fun_activity.instructions: Imagine you are the Mayor of your city! Write down three new rules you would make to keep your city clean, green, and happy for everyone.

quick_recap: ⭐ Big cities are governed by Municipal Corporations, and smaller towns by Municipal Councils.
⭐ Cities are divided into Wards, and each Ward elects a Councillor to represent them.
⭐ The urban local government provides essential services like water, electricity, and waste collection.
